ducted_comparison.allowance_basis: Retain every common quad frame/harness/flight-electronics allowance. ducted_comparison.curve_basis: Manufacturer stabilized-voltage sweep with small r=6 mm inlet lip, at 21 C and 50 m ASL. Linear interpolation only inside supplied data. ducted_comparison.yaw_gate: These fixed EDF products have no documented matched reverse-rotation assemblies or installed net reaction-torque curve in the cited data. Do not apply the propeller quad zero-yaw mixer to them. Stator-equipped aircraft in the cited study use deflecting vanes; applicability, actuator dynamics, loss and mounting envelope must be designed here.

spec.allowance_basis: Retain every common quad frame/harness/flight-electronics allowance. Add separately a fan plus intake ring, ESC per fan, inlet/outlet protection and mounting per fan, and a provisional yaw-control assembly. No CAD clearance, ESC model, guard loss or yaw-control qualification is implied. Do not reduce structure simply because ducts are smaller.
spec.curve_basis: Manufacturer stabilized-voltage sweep with small r=6 mm inlet lip, at 21 C and 50 m ASL. Linear interpolation only inside supplied data. Power versus thrust is an equivalent-operating-point estimate, not a fixed-6S partial-throttle curve. No extrapolation below the first point.
spec.yaw_gate: These fixed EDF products have no documented matched reverse-rotation assemblies or installed net reaction-torque curve in the cited data. Do not apply the propeller quad zero-yaw mixer to them. Stator-equipped aircraft in the cited study use deflecting vanes; applicability, actuator dynamics, loss and mounting envelope must be designed here.
